scope.purpose: Immutable evidence manifest for isolated raw observation, source planar pair impulse, and source polygon/passive-kinematics components.

rules: No component in this manifest creates or admits an event, canonicalizes a peer pair, assigns impact_sequence, runs collision cooldown, validates a collision role, applies HP, or authorizes server damage.
Do not apply the pair resolver impulse to Godot native bodies: the native physics solver has already responded, so doing so would double-apply body force.
Do not derive source impact speed, directed delta-V, HP, or energy from a later native reported impulse.
A raw collector envelope is consumable only with valid=true and complete=true; count-at-cap, identity, nonfinite, or other collection gaps must fail closed.
Caller tick and self identity carried by the raw collector are observations, not authoritative clock or registry proof.

Wrapper valid fields mean only that the wrapper admitted the documented input container or finite shape. They do not mean a contact resolved, an event was admitted, a role was verified, or damage is authorized.
Pair math success is source_result.resolved, but even a resolved result remains proposal-only and non-authoritative.
Polygon geometry success is a non-null source_result, but it does not prove that the obstacle has an authored source-blocking collision role.
unresolved_integration_gaps: Authoritative global physics tick and live target/counterpart identity-life validation.
Canonical peer event creation, target-scoped replay ledger, and independent per-target impact_sequence allocation.
Source target-global and canonical pair cooldown ownership.
A reviewed adapter that retains one coherent onset observation and receives already-resolved semantic impact speed without using native J/m.

passive_static.qualification: Source contactKinematics uses only speed and travelYaw; it omits yaw-arm and peer relative velocity.

peer_pair.qualification: Requires one canonical pre-solve source-axis pair input; each directed delta-V belongs to its own target receipt.

active_static.qualification: No component here decides active-static admission or turns a raw closing observation into an authorized impact.

api: collect(state: PhysicsDirectBodyState3D, self_ref: Dictionary, global_physics_tick: int) -> Dictionary

tests.scope: Actual translated/rotated wall zero-J onset then later J, exact world interpretation, immutable exports, and actual eight-contact fail-closed cap.
Invalid self/tick, actual unbound identity gaps, sibling/later mutation isolation, forbidden authority fields, and repeated actual wall chronology.

components.qualification: duplicate-index and counterpart-overflow flags are structural fail-closed fields but are not independently exercised because retained rows are assigned dense indices and are capped at eight; cap_gap covers unobservable ninth contacts.

contract.wrapper_valid_means: Dictionary containers admitted; not contact resolution or authority.

tests.scope: 278 actual-source transcript cases, 3926 numeric comparisons, tagged nonfinite/extreme cases, swap, momentum, energy, purity, and boundaries.
512 analytic/deterministic cases, 271 resolved, directed signs and inverse-mass ratio, restitution, conservation, purity, and malformed boundaries.

components.qualification: Safe malformed-container nonthrow behavior intentionally differs from a JavaScript destructuring throw; finite source result math is otherwise the declared parity scope.

contract.wrapper_valid_means: Finite input shape admitted; not convexity, winding, collision, finite extreme output, role, event, or authority.
contract.contact_result_field: source_result; null means no source contact

tests.scope: 275 actual-source transcript cases, 3788 numeric comparisons, 199 finite contacts, ordering/ties, support-face clipping, touching, NaN/Infinity, passive motion, purity, and boundaries.
192 rotated rectangles, 190 contacts, tie order, clipped corner/support, zero edge, NaN/Infinity precedence, touching/separation, scaling, and passive linear-only kinematics.

components.qualification: Strict finite wrapper and deep-copied native output intentionally differ from throwable malformed input and shallow-alias JavaScript behavior; these safety differences confer no collision-role or runtime authority.

measurement_policy.performance_claim: Any component timing in its test receipt is isolated wall latency only, not FPS, aggregate CPU, fleet budget, GPU, or LIVE evidence.

adoption_gate.required_next: A separately reviewed authoritative contact-event owner and adapter must close the documented authority gaps without applying native body force twice.
